import pandas as pd

xls = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for name in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} | shape={df.shape} ---")
    print(df.to_string(max_colwidth=30))

import sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = "budget.xlsx"
wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} (dims {ws.dimensions}) ===")
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        vals = [(c.coordinate, c.value) for c in row if c.value is not None]
        if vals:
            print(vals)

import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook

PATH = "budget.xlsx"

print("=== OPENPYXL GRID (formulas + cached values) ===")
wb_formulas = load_workbook(PATH, data_only=False)
wb_values = load_workbook(PATH, data_only=True)
print("SHEETS:", wb_formulas.sheetnames)
for ws_f in wb_formulas.worksheets:
    ws_v = wb_values[ws_f.title]
    print(f"\n--- SHEET: {ws_f.title} | max_row={ws_f.max_row} max_col={ws_f.max_column} ---")
    for r_f, r_v in zip(ws_f.iter_rows(), ws_v.iter_rows()):
        parts = []
        for cf, cv in zip(r_f, r_v):
            if cf.value is not None:
                formula = cf.value if isinstance(cf.value, str) and cf.value.startswith("=") else ""
                val = cv.value if cv.value is not None else cf.value
                parts.append(f"{cf.coordinate}={val!r}{(' [formula: ' + formula + ']') if formula else ''}")
        if parts:
            print(" | ".join(parts))

print("\n=== PANDAS VIEW PER SHEET ===")
xls = pd.ExcelFile(PATH)
for name in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name=name, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- SHEET: {name} shape={df.shape} ---")
    print(df.to_string())
    print("\nNon-null columns and values:")
    for col in df.columns:
        vals = df[col].dropna()
        if not vals.empty:
            print(f"  col {col}: {vals.tolist()}")

import sys

import pandas as pd

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print("=== SHEET:", name, "shape:", df.shape)
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=200, max_cols=40))
    print()
